title: Delete a network device
summary: Remove a network device from the kernel's list of interfaces. This is typically used for virtual interfaces or devices that are no longer needed.

steps.explain: Use `sudo ip link delete` followed by the device name to remove it.

placeholders.name: DEVICE
placeholders.description: The name of the network device to delete.

alternatives.explain: Use the short form `sudo ip l d`.

placeholders.name: DEVICE
placeholders.description: The name of the network device to delete.

rollback.explain: Deleted devices cannot be restored with a simple command. You must recreate the device (e.g., using `ip link add` for virtual devices) or reload the driver for physical devices.

warnings: Deleting a physical network device will disconnect you from the network and may require a reboot or driver reload to restore.
